title: Battle of Kharkiv
summary: The term 'Battle of Kharkiv' encompasses several significant military engagements related to the city of Kharkiv, Ukraine, spanning from World War I to contemporary conflicts, particularly during the ongoing Russian invasion of Ukraine.

sections.heading: Historical Context
paragraphs: The [[kharkiv-oblast|Kharkiv]] Operation, which occurred in June 1919, is one of the earliest military actions associated with the city during the tumultuous period following World War I.

sections.heading: World War II Engagements
paragraphs: During World War II, Kharkiv was the site of four major battles, each contributing to the city's strategic significance. The [[first-battle-of-kharkov|First Battle of Kharkov]] took place in October 1941, followed by the [[second-battle-of-kharkov|Second Battle of Kharkov]] in May 1942, and the Third Battle of [[kharkiv|Kharkov]] in February 1943.
The Belgorod–Kharkov offensive operation, also recognized as the Fourth Battle of Kharkov, occurred in August 1943, marking a pivotal moment in the conflict.

sections.heading: Recent Conflicts
paragraphs: In the context of the ongoing Russian [[full-scale-russo-ukrainian-war|invasion of Ukraine]], the Battle of Kharkiv began in February 2022, highlighting the city's continued strategic importance.
This was followed by the [[2022-kharkiv-counteroffensive|2022 Kharkiv counteroffensive]], which commenced in September 2022, showcasing [[ukraine|Ukraine]]'s military response to the invasion.
Looking ahead, the 2024 Kharkiv offensive is anticipated to begin in May 2024, indicating the ongoing military relevance of Kharkiv in the conflict.
